used_for: VCF format defines structural-variant and copy-number representation: section 5.3 'Encoding Structural Variants'; reserved symbolic ALT types DEL, DUP ('Region of elevated copy number relative to the reference'), INV, CNV ('Copy number variable region'), BND; INFO SVTYPE; FORMAT CN ('Copy number genotype for imprecise events').
PharmCAT does not recommend calling CYP2D6 from VCF because CYP2D6 phenotype is sensitive to SV and CNV; it accepts outside calls (-po), suggesting tools such as StellarPGx on WGS CRAM/BAM.
